description: Defines the ul_tti_request_builder class for constructing UL_TTI.request messages, including methods to add various PDUs and set parameters, within the ocudu::fapi namespace.

classes.name: ul_tti_request_builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing UL_TTI.request messages, providing methods to set basic parameters and add various PDUs such as PRACH, PUCCH, PUSCH, and SRS.

methods.name: set_basic_parameters
methods.description: Sets the basic parameters of the UL_TTI.request message, specifically the slot point.

methods.name: add_prach_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PRACH PDU to the message and returns a builder to fill its parameters.

methods.name: add_pucch_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PUCCH PDU with specified format type to the message and returns a builder to fill its parameters.

methods.name: add_pucch_pdu (overload)
methods.description: Adds a PUCCH PDU with RNTI and format type, setting UE-specific parameters.

methods.name: add_pusch_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PUSCH PDU to the message and returns a builder to fill its parameters.

methods.name: add_pusch_pdu (overload)
methods.description: Adds a PUSCH PDU with RNTI, setting UE-specific parameters.

methods.name: add_srs_pdu
methods.description: Adds an SRS PDU to the message and returns a builder to fill its parameters.
